title: Wiki: Progression
summary: Upgrade Wiki in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Upgrade Path
blocks.body: Progress by using Wiki as a route memory. Follow related articles, open module manuals, check debug warnings when content is missing, and return with better questions.

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step is usually boring because it is the safety layer: storage, markers, meters, counters, backups, or notes. Build that layer before raising the risk.

blocks.title: Ready For More
blocks.body: You are ready to push Wiki further when the current loop feels repeatable, the failure signs are familiar, and the next upgrade has a clear purpose.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
